title: Kitten dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- ground shadow -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='90' rx='26' ry='5' fill='#2b1f4a'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M28 70 Q10 62 14 46 Q17 38 24 42 Q21 52 32 60' fill='#f7a94b' stroke='#ffd98a' stroke-width='3' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='68' rx='18' ry='20' fill='#f7a94b' stroke='#ffd98a' stroke-width='3'/>
  <!-- belly patch -->
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='72' rx='10' ry='12' fill='#ffe6b8'/>
  <!-- left leg (dancing) -->
  <path d='M36 84 Q30 88 24 84 Q28 92 38 90 Z' fill='#f7a94b' stroke='#ffd98a' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <!-- right leg (dancing) -->
  <path d='M60 84 Q68 88 74 82 Q72 92 60 90 Z' fill='#f7a94b' stroke='#ffd98a' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <!-- left arm raised -->
  <path d='M34 60 Q22 52 20 40' fill='none' stroke='#f7a94b' stroke-width='7' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M34 60 Q22 52 20 40' fill='none' stroke='#ffd98a' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round' stroke-dasharray='1 100'/>
  <circle cx='20' cy='39' r='4.5' fill='#ffe6b8'/>
  <!-- right arm out -->
  <path d='M62 60 Q76 56 80 46' fill='none' stroke='#f7a94b' stroke-width='7' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='80' cy='45' r='4.5' fill='#ffe6b8'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='34' rx='20' ry='17' fill='#f7a94b' stroke='#ffd98a' stroke-width='3'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <path d='M32 22 L30 8 L44 17 Z' fill='#f7a94b' stroke='#ffd98a' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <path d='M35 20 L34 13 L41 17 Z' fill='#ff9db5'/>
  <path d='M64 22 L66 8 L52 17 Z' fill='#f7a94b' stroke='#ffd98a' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <path d='M61 20 L62 13 L55 17 Z' fill='#ff9db5'/>
  <!-- eyes: happy -->
  <path d='M38 32 Q42 27 46 32' fill='none' stroke='#3a2352' stroke-width='2.6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M52 32 Q56 27 60 32' fill='none' stroke='#3a2352' stroke-width='2.6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx='34' cy='40' r='4' fill='#ff9db5' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='40' r='4' fill='#ff9db5' opacity='0.8'/>
  <!-- nose and smile -->
  <path d='M46 38 L50 38 L48 40 Z' fill='#ff9db5'/>
  <path d='M43 42 Q48 47 53 42' fill='none' stroke='#3a2352' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- whiskers -->
  <path d='M28 37 L20 35 M28 41 L20 43' stroke='#ffe6b8' stroke-width='1.6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M68 37 L76 35 M68 41 L76 43' stroke='#ffe6b8' stroke-width='1.6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- music notes -->
  <g fill='#7de2d1'>
    <circle cx='84' cy='24' r='3'/>
    <rect x='86' y='10' width='2' height='14'/>
    <circle cx='14' cy='22' r='3'/>
    <rect x='16' y='8' width='2' height='14'/>
  </g>
</svg>
